ASSESSMENT & PLAN: Mr. ___ is a ___ year old gentleman with

CAD s/p CABG x2 and OSA (not on CPAP) with new diagnosis of 
stage IV diffuse large B cell lymphoma with extra-axial mass 
compressing brain parenchyma; and RUE DVT on Lovenox who is s/p
C2 of IFF + HD MTX, 2C of RCHOP, now presenting for C4 HD MTX.

#Diffuse large B cell lymphoma, germinal center type: He has 
mesenteric lymphadenopathy, but his predominant disease is 
extra-axial mass compressing brain parenchyma with likely 
parenchymal invasion into the left frontal lobe.

His initial 
presentation was with severe neurologic symptoms and these 
symptoms have improved overtime with active therapy.

He is now 
alternating between HD MTX and R-CHOP, now s/p of C4 HD MTX.

He is eating and drinking 
well.
-Continue Keppra for seizure PPX and Dexamethasone

-Due for R-CHOP on ___, will reschedule given patient's 
transportation issue to ___

-Repeat MRI Brain in-house shows interval improvement in his CNS 
disease

-Gave RX for Lidocaine PRN if he were to develop mouth sores 
following completion of this cycle

#PICC-associated RUE DVT: Noted new occlusive deep vein 
thrombosis per U/S on ___ in 1 of the right brachial vein, 
near the insertion of the PICC and occlusion of a segment of the
PICC lumen in the region of the right axillary vein.

Repeat U/S on ___ continues to show a 
non-occlusive thrombus within the right brachial vein.

likely due to hyper-hydration following HD MTX completion.
